_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for MindTwin crisis phrase rules.
Consumed by ml_service/crisis_rules.py directly, and copied (by ml_service/tools/sync_crisis_lexicon.py) into
backend/src/routes/ml.js and lib/services/ml_sentiment_service.dart between GENERATED markers.
After editing this file run: python ml_service/tools/sync_crisis_lexicon.py  (CI: --check).
Matching contract (identical in Python, JS, Dart):
normalize(text): lowercase; map curly quotes/backtick to an apostrophe then delete apostrophes (don't -> dont);
replace every ASCII char that is not [a-z0-9] and the chars in 'extra_separators' with a space; collapse spaces; trim.
A pattern P matches when the regex  (?:^| )(?:P)(?= |$)  is found in the normalized text.
Patterns must not contain backslashes or apostrophes so they embed verbatim in JS and Dart raw strings.
hard: ALWAYS escalate (explicit/passive ideation, self-harm, method/plan). Never suppressed by idioms or negation.
soft: escalate for therapist review (hopelessness / burdensomeness). Never suppressed by idioms.
idiom: only suppresses a MODEL-ONLY escalation (no hard or soft phrase present).
negation: only annotates a hard hit (negation_present=true); it NEVER suppresses escalation (C-SSRS: any SI mention needs review).
model_threshold: model-only escalation fires at probability >= this (chosen 0.35 from the threshold sweep in docs/ML_SAFETY_EVALUATION.md; recall prioritised over precision).
